title: A rapid and bidirectional reporter of neural activity reveals neural correlates of social behaviors in Drosophila.
authors: Bonheur, Moise; Swartz, Kurtis J; Metcalf, Melissa G; Wen, Xinke; Zhukovskaya, Anna; Mehta, Avirut; Connors, Kristin E; Barasch, Julia G; Jamieson, Andrew R; Martin, Kelsey C; Axel, Richard; Hattori, Daisuke
one_liner_zh: 该文开发果蝇神经活动报告器并研究社交行为神经关联，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neural activity is modulated over different timescales encompassing subseconds to hours, reflecting changes in external environment, internal state and behavior. Using Drosophila as a model, we developed a rapid and bidirectional reporter that provides a cellular readout of recent neural activity. This reporter uses nuclear versus cytoplasmic distribution of CREB-regulated transcriptional co-activator (CRTC). Subcellular distribution of GFP-tagged CRTC (CRTC::GFP) bidirectionally changes on the order of minutes and reflects both increases and decreases in neural activity. We established an automated machine-learning-based routine for efficient quantification of reporter signal. Using this reporter, we demonstrate mating-evoked activation and inactivation of modulatory neurons. We further investigated the functional role of the master courtship regulator gene fruitless (fru) and show that fru is necessary to ensure activation of male arousal neurons by female cues. Together, our results establish CRTC::GFP as a bidirectional reporter of recent neural activity suitable for examining neural correlates in behavioral contexts.
abstract_zh: 神经活动在不同时间尺度上受到调节，涵盖从亚秒到小时的范围，反映了外部环境、内部状态和行为的变化。以果蝇为模型，我们开发了一种快速且双向的报告分子，能够提供近期神经活动的细胞读数。该报告分子利用CREB调控的转录共激活因子（CRTC）的核质分布。GFP标记的CRTC（CRTC::GFP）的亚细胞分布在分钟级别上双向变化，并反映神经活动的增加和减少。我们建立了一种基于机器学习的自动化流程，用于高效量化报告信号。利用此报告分子，我们展示了交配诱发的调节性神经元的激活和失活。我们进一步研究了主求偶调控基因fruitless（fru）的功能作用，并表明fru对于确保雌性线索诱导雄性唤醒神经元的激活是必需的。综合来看，我们的结果确立了CRTC::GFP作为近期神经活动的双向报告分子，适用于在行为情境中检查神经相关性。
